1/7 🚨 Every month, millions of job & visa applicants get rejected by government portals (UPSC, SSC, US Visa, Schengen) because their photo is 51 KB instead of 50 KB.

We built PressZero to solve this forever — with 0 server uploads.

Here is how it works: 👇

2/7 The Problem with Online Compressors:

When you use tools like TinyPNG or random resizing websites:
1. Your sensitive Aadhaar, PAN, and passport are uploaded to remote cloud servers.
2. You get vague 'quality' sliders. Guess 80%? 74 KB. Guess 60%? Blurry mess.

3/7 The PressZero Bisection Engine:

Instead of guessing, PressZero runs a binary search on the image's quantization matrix right in your browser via Web Workers.

You set the target to 50 KB. The engine dynamically brackets the file and hits 49.8 KB in < 80ms.

4/7 AI Signature & Stamp Bleaching:

Taking a phone photo of your signature always results in yellow paper and desk shadows. Portals reject this.

Our adaptive Otsu thresholding bleaches the background to 100% pure RGB(255, 255, 255) without thinning ink strokes.

5/7 Biometric Smart Cropping:

No more manual pixel math. We built one-click presets for:
- US Visa (2x2 in, 600x600)
- Schengen Visa (35x45 mm)
- UPSC / SSC Exam (3.5x4.5 cm)

With biometric eye and chin guidelines.

6/7 Zero-Knowledge Guarantee:

🛡️ 0 Bytes Egress

🔓 MIT Licensed & Fully Open Source

Your biometric data never touches any server.
